title: Padded runs match source runs
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Boolean-alphabet Turing machine with $k$ work tapes, let $K\in\mathbb{N}$ satisfy $k\le K$, and let $c$ be a configuration of $M$ on a Boolean input word $x$. For every $t\in\mathbb{N}$, the padded machine's configuration after $t$ steps from the padded $c$ is the padding of $M$'s configuration after $t$ steps from $c$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite Boolean-alphabet Turing machine $M$ with $k$ work tapes
replaced: For every machine with $k \le K$ tapes, source configuration, and duration $t$, running the padded machine for $t$ steps from the padded configuration equals padding the source's $t$-step run; the padded source observes exactly its original work symbols.
